items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: And we'd use two trumpets. Son Allen, we'd get this boy Shots, a record.

ctx.x: Who did you have a trumpet?

Well, during that time we were going to Perrikan. We would use Son Allen. He'd look at—we had to have a big band up there. He's playing mostly—we had two bands, you see? One band in each corner. Baby Every Wizzley band, maybe Outer Town band, you know? Clayborne Williams band. We used two bands. We used to play a band. We used to play a band. And we'd use two trumpets. Son Allen, we'd get this boy Shots, a record.
You changed your own a little bit.
